name: eMudhra Ltd
title: eMudhra Ltd - 543533 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Software/PKI firm, not a capital-cycle story: FY26 PAT ₹1,100m (+26%) with FY27 guided at 18% top line and 25–30% PAT growth, but Q4 PAT rose only 21.6% and no capacity discipline is discussed.

triggers.label: FY27 PAT growth 25–30%
triggers.quote: bottom line may be around between 25% to 30%. Could be around 27%- 28% kind of thing.

triggers.label: Order book ~2.2–2.3x next year
triggers.quote: we have projected little over 2X maybe 2.2X-2.3X the order book as the next year projection.

triggers.label: Middle East orders delayed
triggers.quote: some of the Middle East orders which would have come in March, they are all getting delayed.

guidance.quote: Most likely 18% organic growth is possible. This is what we are expecting.
bottom line may be around between 25% to 30%. Could be around 27%- 28% kind of thing.
we want to double the bottom line in a 3-year timeframe.

red_flags.label: Q4 PAT growth slowed to 21.6%
red_flags.quote: Profit after tax for the quarter was INR 296 million, reflecting a 21.6% year -over-year growth

red_flags.label: Dispute with 3i Infotech unresolved
red_flags.quote: nothing really has progressed on either side compared to what it was 2 months back.

evasions.quote: Quantify this deal, we are not supposed to intimate the number for each separate deal.
that will also depend on how far they are able to sell our CLM solution instead of the American CLM solution and all that.
